extDescription.message: Sign in on your computer with one tap. Purr brings your 2FA code from your phone or a security key. It never sees your secret.

popupUnpairedTitle.message: Your phone is the key. This is the keyhole.

popupUnpairedSub.message: Pair your phone once and signing in becomes a tap. Your codes stay on the phone — this extension never sees the secret.

popupNoFieldSub.message: Open this on a page asking for a six-digit code, and the code can come straight from your phone.

popupFillKeySub.message: Touch your security key — your phone stays in your pocket

popupAskPhoneSub.message: Approve there and the code lands here

popupReadySubKey.message: Touch your key to fill the code right here, or ask your phone.

popupReadySubPhone.message: Your code has to come from something you're holding — your phone.

popupReadyFootnote.message: Only the six digits ever reach the page. You can close this — a phone approval still fills in when you tap Approve.

popupKeyTouchSub.message: Tap your security key to unlock this code right here — nothing leaves this computer but the six digits.

popupSentSub.message: Approve it there and the code lands here. You can close this window — it keeps working.

popupFilledSub.message: Your phone made the code and sent only those six digits. Nothing else crossed over.

popupClipSub.message: We couldn't find the code box on this page, so copy it in yourself:

popupDeniedSub.message: No code was sent. If that was a mistake, ask again — if it wasn't, change your password for this site.

popupExpiredTitle.message: That request ran out of time

popupExpiredSub.message: Requests expire after a minute so an old one can't be approved by accident. Nothing went wrong — just ask again.

popupUnreachableSub.message: It might be asleep, out of signal, or face-down on a table. Nothing's wrong with your account.

popupOpenApp.message: Or open the app and read the code

popupUnmatchedSub.message: If you already have this account on your phone under a different name, open it there and approve — this popup will remember the match next time.

optIntroHero.message: Your phone is the key. This is the keyhole.

optIntroCopy.message: Pairing takes about a minute. After that, signing in anywhere is a tap on your phone — no codes to type, nothing to remember.

optTick1.message: Your codes stay on your phone. This extension never sees the secret.

optTick2.message: Works with no account. Nothing to sign up for.

optTick3.message: Unpair from either side, any time.

optGetApp.message: Get the app first, if you haven't

optScanErrCopy.message: Check the connection and try again. Nothing was set up yet, so nothing is half-done.

optScanCopy.message: Open Purr on your phone, tap {0}, then hold it up to the square.

optPairedCopy.message: Next time a site asks for a code, this extension will spot it and ask your phone. You'll just tap Approve.

optSecWhenAsks.message: When a site asks for a code

optFillAuto.message: Fill it in for me automatically

optFillAutoSub.message: After you approve — we never fill without a tap somewhere

optSubmit.message: Submit the form once it's filled

optSubmitSub.message: Saves a click; turn off if a site behaves oddly

optLeadKeySub.message: Offer the key touch first; your phone stays a tap away

optSecKeys.message: Sign in with a security key

optKeysBlurb.message: Touch a registered key to fill a code on this computer with your phone in your pocket. Your codes live here only as ciphertext; the key is what unlocks them.

optUnpairNote.message: Unpairing only affects this browser. Your codes stay on your phone, untouched.

optNoRules.message: No special rules yet. Rules land here when you add one.

optNoWebauthn.message: This browser doesn't support security keys.

optKeyRegistered.message: ✓ {0} registered. Tap "Test unlock" and touch it to confirm.

optKeyRegisteredWarn.message: ⚠ {0} registered, but it may not support touch-to-unlock. Try Test unlock to be sure.

optConfirmTouch.message: Confirm a touch unlocks the vault

optUnlockOk.message: ✓ {0} unlocks Purr here. You're all set.

optTurnOnKeySignin.message: Turn on sign-in with your key

optKeySigninOn.message: ✓ Key sign-in on with {0}. Open the phone app once so it syncs your vault here.

optKeySigninIsOnSub.message: On a site's code field, touch your key to fill it — your phone stays in your pocket.

optTouchEnrolledThenNew.message: Touch an enrolled key, then the new one…

optBackupAdded.message: ✓ {0} added — it's now a backup key.

optKeySigninOff.message: Key sign-in turned off on this computer.

optLanguageSub.message: Choose how Purr speaks to you here
